mechanics.name: Do No Harm
mechanics.currentEffect: While healing another Survivor, for each Hook State they have: you heal 30/35/40% faster, Great basic Skill Checks grant 3% more progress, and the odds of triggering a Skill Check increase by 5%.
activation: Heal another Survivor; all three bonuses scale with that Survivor's Hook States and do nothing at zero Hook States.
Ends/deactivates when: The bonuses apply only while healing another Survivor.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Adjusted healing speed to 30/35/40% per Hook State, tied the +3% Great basic Skill Check progress to Hook States, and added +5% Skill Check occurrence chance.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Healing a teammate who has Hook States is faster, gives stronger Great basic Skill Check progress, and causes Skill Checks more often, all scaling with each Hook State.
specialInteractions: Great basic Healing Skill Checks grant +3% progress per Hook State of the Survivor being healed.
Healing Skill Check occurrence chance is increased by 5% per Hook State of the Survivor being healed (maximum 10% at 2 Hook States).

editorial.summary: Heal teammates faster for each Hook State they have, reaching up to 80% faster at two Hook States, with stronger and more frequent Great healing Skill Checks.
useCases: Reset a death-hook teammate extremely quickly.
Combine with healing builds to make late-game support very efficient.
Exploit Great Skill Checks for additional progress on already-hooked teammates.
counters: Provides no bonus on teammates with zero Hook States.
The strongest bonus appears only on Survivors already close to elimination.
pros: Very large healing ceiling on death-hook teammates.
Targets the teammates who most need safe resets.
cons: Can be redundant if another perk already makes the heal nearly instant.
analysis: Do No Harm remains a strong triage perk, but its 10.2 Tier III ceiling is now 40% faster healing per Hook State, or 80% on a teammate with two Hook States.
The Skill Check package adds more texture: Great basic healing checks grant 3% extra progress and Hook States also increase the chance that healing Skill Checks occur.
That makes the perk especially effective on the teammate the team most needs to protect, because death-hook Survivors receive both the largest speed bonus and more opportunities for bonus progress.

It is still conditional on the target having Hook States, so the opening of a Trial can remain quiet. The 10.2 adjustments reduce the raw ceiling slightly while making the Skill Check portion more reliable.
editorial.verdict: Still a strong death-hook triage perk. The live ceiling is now 80% faster healing at two Hook States, with more Skill Check opportunities supporting the reset.
